'''Bespin''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]] of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] on the [[Ison Trade Corridor/Legends|Ison Corridor]] in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was also a major source of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas, which was refined for production and transport in numerous [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations including [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] and [[Tibannopolis]]. It was home to several million individuals, including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]], and [[Lutrillian/Legends|Lutrillians]].

==Overview==
[[File:Cloud_City.png|thumb|left|250px|[[BesGas Three]], to the left of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].]]
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Bespin was a gas giant that was about 118,000 kilometers in diameter. Like most gas giants, it had a solid core made of metal (in this case, [[Rethen/Legends|rethen]], 6,000 kilometers in diameter) followed by layers of metallic gases. Most of the layers of gas were poisonous, and the pressure and temperature were far above what a Human could tolerate. Despite this, from approximately 150 to 180 kilometers down from [[Realspace/Legends|space]] there was a 30 kilometer thick habitable layer known as the Bespin [[Life Zone/Legends|Life Zone]]. This layer had an [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] with temperature and pressure suitable for Human life, shielded by the layers below and replenished by airborne [[Algae/Legends|algae]].<ref name="CL" /> It was in this layer that Cloud City was located. As with many gas giants, Bespin had a number of [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Bespin had a twelve-hour day, and completed a revolution around its [[Star/Legends|star]] approximately once every fourteen [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]].<ref name="Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 3">[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 3|''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 3]] - Guide to the Galaxy: Bespin's Settlements</ref>

Bespin's fauna included the winged [[Tibannuck]]s,<ref name="daa" /> [[Velker/Legends|velkers]],<ref name="EAWGG" /> [[Rawwk/Legends|rawwks]],<ref name="JS">''[[Jedi Search]]''</ref> the gas-filled [[Beldon/Legends|beldon]], and airborne algae sacks. Bespin was the type class of the ''Bespin''-class gas giant.<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

==History==
===Old Republic era===
The planet was first discovered by the explorers from the [[Hyperspace Navigator's Guild]] in years prior to the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The carbonite-rich [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] established a small gas operation on the planet, but it was mostly destroyed during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] by a fleet of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warships, hoping to break up the [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas supply chain for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

Bespin was first colonized in [[1989 BBY]].<ref name="KOTORCG" /> The planet had its own [[Jedi enclave (Bespin)|Jedi enclave]]. During the [[New Sith Wars]], the [[Brotherhood of Darkness/Legends|Brotherhood of Darkness]] [[Battle of Bespin (New Sith Wars)|captured]] the planet.<ref name="DB:POD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref> [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]] commissioned Cloud City to be built by the [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]].

===Rise of the Empire era===
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet initially attempted to stay neutral. A Republic warship delivered dozens of orphans to an orphanage there in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], including a young [[Boba Fett]], who later [[Escape from Bespin|escaped]].<ref name="Crossfire">''[[Boba Fett: Crossfire]]''</ref> Though always a vital source of Tibanna gas, Bespin’s strategic value surged during the war.<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide" /> Despite Bespin's declaration of neutrality, the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Battle of Bespin (Clone Wars)|launched an invasion]] of the planet, which was defended by at least one [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], [[Glynn-Beti]].<ref name="Tethan Battle Adventures">''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: Tethan Battle Adventure]]''</ref> The planet, including its Tibanna gas colonies, fell to the Separatists initially.<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref><ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars video game">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (video game)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' video game]]</ref> The planet eventually swung back into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] hands after a series of orbital battles and [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfights]].<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> Separatist [[General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]] intended to target Bespin with a bio-weapon, but it was [[Battle of Lanteeb|destroyed]] on [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]] before he could deploy it.<ref name="Siege">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Siege]]''</ref>

After the Republic was [[Declaration of a New Order|reorganized]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the planet was placed under Imperial control,<ref name="IGP">[[Intergalactic Passport (real-life artifact)|Intergalactic Passport]]</ref> although it was largely left alone beyond that.

<div style="float:right">[[File:Bespin_skyscrapers.png|thumb|left|250px|Cloud City's skyline at sunset]]</div>
This was the planet on which [[Galen Marek]] found [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] [[2 BBY/Legends|when]] he was searching for potential leaders of the Rebel Alliance. The former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] had hidden himself on one of Bespin's many [[Bespin construction platform|construction platforms]] and Marek fought one of the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Shadow Guard|Shadow Guard]] during the meeting.<ref name="TFU:C">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed (graphic novel)|''The Force Unleashed'' comic]]</ref> Marek also [[Rescue of Garm Bel Iblis|rescued]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]] while [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] was filled with criminals and thugs.<ref name="TFU">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] served as [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. He helped provide well-paying jobs for the Ugnaughts, and was admired and liked by the citizens of Cloud City.

When Han Solo, along with [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] came to [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] to escape from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], they walked into a trap set up by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], which Lando was forced into aiding. Han Solo was frozen into [[Carbonite/Legends|Carbonite]] and Leia Organa and Chewbacca were to remain in the city. As Boba Fett brought Han onto his ship, [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']], Lando with Lobot's help, got the two out of Imperial custody along with a damaged Threepio and tried to rescue Han from Fett but failed.<ref name="ESB" />

[[File:LukeApproachesBespin-MOTESB.png|thumb|left|200px|Luke Skywalker's X-wing approaches Bespin]]
Meanwhile, Luke Skywalker [[Duel on Cloud City|dueled]] Vader, lost his right hand, and Vader revealed that he was Luke's father. Pinned between the choice of going with his long-lost father or dying by his blade, Luke plunged into an air vent. When he fell, he managed to grasp onto a weather vane beneath the city. In pain from his wound and his new knowledge, Luke pleaded for [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] help, to no avail. He managed to telepathically communicate with Leia, and was rescued by the ''Millennium Falcon''. The ''Falcon'' in turn managed to escape from the [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] when [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] fixed the disabled [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].<ref name="ESB" />

However, a garrison of troops was left on the planet, and the garrison [[Occupation of Bespin|fought]] against the Rebel Alliance and Bespin security forces for control of Cloud City's [[Gravity Control Generator]]s. The garrison also destroyed the [[Bespin Government Center]] and built an [[Imperial Palace (Monument)|Imperial Palace]] in its place to cement their occupation.<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref> Calrissian's former assistant, [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]], temporarily ousted the garrison from the planet by tricking them into thinking Cloud City's [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] pods were compromised.<ref name="SW57">[[Star Wars (1977) 57|''Star Wars'' (1977) 57]]</ref>

The [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] also raided Bespin during this time, with its leader [[Tyber Zann]], [[IG-88B|IG-88]], and [[Urai Fen]], participating in a mission to steal Tibanna gas. They were successful in doing so and also placed evidence that implicated [[Falleen]] Prince [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] and his rival [[Black Sun]] organization for the attack.<ref name="FOC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>

Later, just before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Raid on Bespin|raided]] the still Imperial-controlled colony with the help of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. The successful raid secured shipment of vital tibanna to the Rebel cause.<ref name="RSII">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]''</ref> The main [[Liberation of Bespin|battle]] to free Bespin was fought right after Endor. Calrissian, now a [[General/Legends|general]] in the Rebel Alliance, led the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel SpecForces]] against the Empire<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref> and successfully ousted the occupying troops.<ref name="DBC">{{DB|character|chyler|Chyler, Tian}}</ref> The Jedi [[X2]] was also involved in liberating the city with the help of Calrissian and Lobot.<ref name="BF:ES">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref> Calrissian himself would eventually return to being Baron Administrator.<ref name="ZtHR">''[[Zorba the Hutt's Revenge]]''</ref>

In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Lando lost the Cloud City to [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]] in a game of [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]].<ref name="ZtHR" /> After Zorba was ousted, Lando turned governance of the city over to King [[Ozz (Ugnaught)/Legends|Ozz]] of the Ugnaughts. Lobot became administrator of the City (possibly under the authority of Ozz). Bespin was later taken over by the Empire in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] and later, the [[Empire Reborn]].<ref name="JKII:JO" /> During the [[Thrawn campaign]], the [[Bespin garrison]] has been installed on the planet. It was used by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to supply the [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] in tibanna gas.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

In [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], Luke Skywalker discovered an elderly man named [[Streen]], who possessed latent Force abilities, living a hermit's life in the abandoned city of [[Tibannopolis]]. Streen's life among the clouds gave him unique abilities to manipulate wind, air, and communing with flying creatures. Streen accompanied Luke to the [[Jedi Praxeum]], where he became one of the earliest students.<ref name="JS" />

In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], [[Kyle Katarn]] [[Battle of Bespin (Empire Reborn)|traveled to Bespin]] after he had met with [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. During this travel, he had wiped out Reelo Baruk's thugs in the [[Industrial Levels|undercity]], dueled and defeated a [[Reborn]], used [[Lando Calrissian's R5 unit|Lando's R5 unit]] to travel to the city's concourse level, drove all [[Empire Reborn|Reborn]] forces out of the city, and defeated [[Tavion Axmis|Tavion]], sparing her life after she revealed that [[Jan Ors]] is still alive.<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast]]''</ref>

[[File:Z95bespindefensefighter.jpg|thumb|right|220px|A [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95]] Bespin Defense Fighter with a [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].]]

===Yuuzhan Vong War===
During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planet remained untargeted by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], due to the fact that there was no planet surface to [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongform]]. Unlike many planets during the war, it remained untouched and isolated.<ref name="LECG" />

===Dark Nest Crisis===
In [[36 ABY]], the planet was plagued with [[tibanna tapper]]s using [[siphoning balloon]]s. [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Zekk]] were assigned to investigate. It was eventually discovered the stolen tibanna was being used for the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] [[nest ship]]s constructed in the [[Tusken's Eye]].<ref name="DNII">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref>

===Second Galactic Civil War===
In [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], along with [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]], [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]], [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] and the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], Bespin almost allied with [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] in an attempt to challenge the benefits of membership in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]], during the Second Galactic Civil War.<ref name="E">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>

===Darth Krayt's empire===
During the time of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] named [[Ormo Haddon]] was the Baron Administrator of Cloud City. Haddon abandoned the outskirts of the city and moved the businesses to the central area.<ref name="LECG" />

==Economy==
The main economy on Bespin was the mining of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas. Tibanna gas was a very important resource used by both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] for powering weapons. When supercharged, the gas could fire a bolt of energy, resulting in the blaster shot. Spinsealed tibanna gas, which occurred naturally on Bespin, had the ability to quadruple the power of blaster bolts passing through it. Most of the settlements on Bespin were mining colonies, such as [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] facility in 3 ABY.

While most of the commercial exploitation of Bespin was done by [[Figg & Associates]], there were also a few gas prospectors. These lone pilots would search the skies for "gas strikes" in their ramshackle vessels, where plumes of deep gas would spurt into the high atmosphere due to internal storms deep below them. Some gas prospectors would ride extremely close to storm systems in the hope of gaining many riches from a gas strike, only to vanish without trace in the massive and unpredictable storms.

During the Galactic Civil War, the Empire stored supplies of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] on Bespin.

==Flora and fauna==
Many animals existed in the high atmosphere of Bespin, included the [[Beldon/Legends|beldon]], a huge floating creature that excreted the tibanna gas that made Bespin famous. [[Velker/Legends|Velkers]],<ref name="EAWGG" /> [[Rawwk/Legends|rawwks]],<ref name="JS" /> and [[tibannuck]]s<ref name="daa" /> also lived in the atmosphere, as well as many other exotic and brightly colored animals, many of which were never properly categorized, often called [[Floater (creature)|floaters]]. Some [[Thranta/Legends|thrantas]] were transported to Bespin, thus allowing them to survive the destruction of their homeworld, [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].

Floating in the gas giant's skies were many different forms of [[Algae/Legends|algae]] and plankton. One kind of algae called "pinks" were so plentiful they gave the sky of Cloud City its distinctive color. Yet another form of algae called [[Glower|"glowers"]] gave the night side of Bespin a distinct purplish glow.<ref name="The Illustrated Star Wars Universe">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MCQ-cloudcity.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Concept art of Bespin by [[Ralph McQuarrie]]]]
In the [[1974]] [[The Star Wars rough draft|rough draft]] of ''A New Hope'', the planet [[Alderaan (The Star Wars)|Alderaan]], which was set as a giant gas planet and the capital of the [[Galactic Empire (The Star Wars)|New Galactic Empire]] at that time, resembled Bespin in ''The Empire Strikes Back''. There was also a [[Imperial City of Alderaan|city]] that resembled [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on that "original Alderaan". Bespin was mentioned in a stamp for the Intergalactic Passport that acted as a backstage pass for ''The Empire Strikes Back'', although most of the stamp was illegible due to apparent wear and tear.

In the early story conferences for ''The Empire Strikes Back'', Ketbrae (also known as Kettlebrae) was a gas giant. It eventually became Bespin.

[[Star Wars (1977) 56|''Star Wars'' (1977) 56]] indicates that Bespin is the home planet of the Ugnaughts, and shows the planet as having a habitable surface &mdash; a phenomenon that is impossible on a gas giant. This error is corrected in the [[Databank (original)|Databank]], which states that Ugnaughts inhabited secret floating platforms below Cloud City. The "surface", which Lando Calrissian plummeted to in the comic, was later established as [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]] in ''[[Bespin: Action Tidings]]''.

Bespin serves as a location for multiple Versus Mode matches in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]''.

In the [[2006]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Empire at War]]'', Bespin cannot be destroyed by the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]] during space combat, but can from the Galactic Map, unlike most planets.

The [[1998]] PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']], mistakenly placed Bespin in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]], though it is actually located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. In another error, the planet map displayed at the original [[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] attraction in [[Disneyland Paris]] and [[Tokyo Disneyland]] places the planet within the [[Bala Trix Nebula]].

Bespin also appeared in two missions in the LEGO re-creation of the [[Original trilogy]] in the [[2006]] video game ''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]''. The missions were also included in the game's [[2007]] [[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga|compilation re-release]].
